metadata.title: Safe Scripts and Word Boundaries in Technical Text

content_items.text: Safe Scripts and Word Boundaries in Technical Text
The explicit forms H<sub>2</sub>O and x<sup>2</sup> must render as scripts without changing ordinary words.
The signal was modified by a deterministic cleanup step and remained readable.
The evaluation firmly established that letters inside ordinary words are not superscripts.

A final sentence preserves spaces between every word and keeps punctuation next to the intended token. The level of β did not increase at 1.2 × 10<sup>−3</sup> mol L<sup>−1</sup> (n = 12). An association does not establish causation.
This deliberately low-value section exists only to test default folding.

translations.translation_zh: 技术文本中的安全角标与单词边界
显式的化学式和平方项应渲染为角标，同时不能改变普通单词。
信号经过确定性清理后仍保持可读。
评估明确证明普通单词中的字母不应成为上标。
最后一句保留所有单词间空格，并让标点紧邻正确的词。在 1.2 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹ 时，β 水平没有升高（n = 12）。关联并不能确立因果关系。
该低价值区域只用于验证默认折叠。

research_question.text: 如何只渲染明确的上下标并保留普通单词？

key_methods.text: 使用包含合法标签和易误判单词的固定文本进行回归。

core_results.text: 合法角标可见，modified 与 firmly 等普通词保持完整。

limitations.text: 样例只覆盖显示合同，不替代真实解析校文。
